title: Installation Delays — Permitting delays
body: Installation Delays — Permitting delays. Assign a permitting specialist to each delayed installation and send the member a dated permit status every three business days.
recommended_action: Assign a permitting specialist to each delayed installation and send the member a dated permit status every three business days.

title: Installation Delays — Installer scheduling
body: Installation Delays — Installer scheduling. Publish installer capacity by metro each Monday and do not book installations beyond the crews on that sheet.
recommended_action: Publish installer capacity by metro each Monday and do not book installations beyond the crews on that sheet.

title: Installation Delays — Customer communication
body: Installation Delays — Customer communication. Send the member a single next-step message within one business day whenever an installation date moves.
recommended_action: Send the member a single next-step message within one business day whenever an installation date moves.

title: Installation Delays — Other
body: Installation Delays — Other. Review installation delays that do not match permitting, installer scheduling, or customer communication in the weekly operations standup.
recommended_action: Review installation delays that do not match permitting, installer scheduling, or customer communication in the weekly operations standup.

title: Battery Performance — Capacity below spec
body: Battery Performance — Capacity below spec. Compare the installed battery capacity with the member's contract and schedule a site check when the reading is short.
recommended_action: Compare the installed battery capacity with the member's contract and schedule a site check when the reading is short.

title: Battery Performance — Backup duration
body: Battery Performance — Backup duration. Log backup duration on every outage ticket and replace packs that fall short of the home-backup window.
recommended_action: Log backup duration on every outage ticket and replace packs that fall short of the home-backup window.

title: Battery Performance — Charge rate
body: Battery Performance — Charge rate. Check the charge rate against the site's electrical panel before telling the member the battery is underperforming.
recommended_action: Check the charge rate against the site's electrical panel before telling the member the battery is underperforming.

title: Battery Performance — Other
body: Battery Performance — Other. Open a battery performance review when the complaint does not match capacity, backup duration, or charge rate.
recommended_action: Open a battery performance review when the complaint does not match capacity, backup duration, or charge rate.

title: Billing Confusion — Rate plan
body: Billing Confusion — Rate plan. Walk the member through the rate plan on the bill and point at the line that changed.
recommended_action: Walk the member through the rate plan on the bill and point at the line that changed.

title: Billing Confusion — Invoice timing
body: Billing Confusion — Invoice timing. Explain invoice timing in one note that names the service window the charge covers.
recommended_action: Explain invoice timing in one note that names the service window the charge covers.

title: Billing Confusion — Credit application
body: Billing Confusion — Credit application. Apply the pending credit on the next bill and tell the member the date it will show.
recommended_action: Apply the pending credit on the next bill and tell the member the date it will show.

title: Billing Confusion — Other
body: Billing Confusion — Other. Escalate billing confusion that is not a rate plan, invoice timing, or credit question to the billing lead.
recommended_action: Escalate billing confusion that is not a rate plan, invoice timing, or credit question to the billing lead.

title: App Problems — Login
body: App Problems — Login. Reset the mobile app login and confirm the member can open the battery status screen.
recommended_action: Reset the mobile app login and confirm the member can open the battery status screen.

title: App Problems — Telemetry display
body: App Problems — Telemetry display. Repair the telemetry display so the app shows the same battery state the device is reporting.
recommended_action: Repair the telemetry display so the app shows the same battery state the device is reporting.

title: App Problems — Notifications
body: App Problems — Notifications. Turn member notifications back on and send a test alert for the next battery event.
recommended_action: Turn member notifications back on and send a test alert for the next battery event.

title: App Problems — Other
body: App Problems — Other. File an app problem that is not login, telemetry display, or notifications with the mobile on-call.
recommended_action: File an app problem that is not login, telemetry display, or notifications with the mobile on-call.

title: Communication Problems — Status updates
body: Communication Problems — Status updates. Send a status update the same day an installation or incident changes, using the member's preferred channel.
recommended_action: Send a status update the same day an installation or incident changes, using the member's preferred channel.

title: Communication Problems — Scheduling calls
body: Communication Problems — Scheduling calls. Return scheduling calls within one business day and record the time the member was reached.
recommended_action: Return scheduling calls within one business day and record the time the member was reached.

title: Communication Problems — Unclear next steps
body: Communication Problems — Unclear next steps. Close every conversation with one unclear-next-steps check so the member can repeat the next step.
recommended_action: Close every conversation with one unclear-next-steps check so the member can repeat the next step.

title: Communication Problems — Other
body: Communication Problems — Other. Review communication problems that are not status updates, scheduling calls, or unclear next steps.
recommended_action: Review communication problems that are not status updates, scheduling calls, or unclear next steps.

title: Operational blocker — permitting
body: Operational blocker — permitting. Track permitting as an operational blocker and pair each permit hold with the member conversation that named it.
recommended_action: Track permitting as an operational blocker and pair each permit hold with the member conversation that named it.

title: Operational blocker — installer capacity
body: Operational blocker — installer capacity. Treat installer capacity as an operational blocker and stop promising dates the metro crew cannot cover.
recommended_action: Treat installer capacity as an operational blocker and stop promising dates the metro crew cannot cover.

title: Operational blocker — customer scheduling
body: Operational blocker — customer scheduling. Treat customer scheduling as an operational blocker and confirm the member's availability before the crew rolls.
recommended_action: Treat customer scheduling as an operational blocker and confirm the member's availability before the crew rolls.

title: Technical issue — battery telemetry
body: Technical issue — battery telemetry. When battery telemetry drops, link the engineering incident to the member complaints that reported the missing data.
recommended_action: When battery telemetry drops, link the engineering incident to the member complaints that reported the missing data.

title: Technical issue — mobile app
body: Technical issue — mobile app. When the mobile app fails, link the engineering incident to the member complaints that described the failure.

title: Technical issue — firmware
body: Technical issue — firmware. When firmware misbehaves, link the engineering incident to the member complaints that showed the fault.
